description: The line plot illustrates the mean interclass similarity of generated training samples across 64 relation categories, with the x-axis representing the relation category (ranging from 0 to 63) and the y-axis showing the mean interclass similarity on a scale from 0.0 to 0.5. The plot compares three methods: "w/o DPO obo" (blue line), "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint" (orange line), and "DPO" (green line), each with corresponding average lines indicated by dashed and dotted lines. The "w/o DPO obo" method shows high variability, with a peak near category 0 at approximately 0.49, followed by a sharp decline and fluctuating values. The "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint" method also exhibits significant variation, with a prominent peak around category 31 at approximately 0.44, and a notable spike near category 60 at approximately 0.48. The "DPO" method displays the most consistent performance, with values generally staying below 0.2 and showing a steady trend. The average values for each method are represented by horizontal lines: the average for "w/o DPO obo" is approximately 0.107, for "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint" it is approximately 0.158, and for "DPO" it is approximately 0.086. These averages are indicated by dashed lines in the plot.
